title: non-scott-continuous-firing-ordinal
description: An ordinal mu < kappa at which a settling's closure operator fails to commute with directed knowledge-joins of earlier stages, marking a transfinite infinitary firing; generated as a distinguished kind within settling-continuity.

ordinal.description: an ordinal mu strictly below the firing bound kappa

closureOperator.description: the settling's closure operator cl whose continuity is in question

noncommutingJoin.description: cl(\/_k {v_sigma : sigma < mu}) != \/_k {cl(v_sigma) : sigma < mu}: closure does not commute with the directed <=_k-join over earlier stages

infinitaryFiring.description: a new cell (s_mu, o_mu) in E x E is added at mu by a closure rule with a forall-antecedent over earlier layers, obtainable from no finite sub-stage

h1Generator.description: contributes exactly one Z-generator to H^1(T*_{<=kappa}, F_U); summing over all such ordinals yields the aperiodic classifying invariant
